_comment: S3 SYNC POLICY — OPENESTATES_LAKE_URL, what syncs to S3, what stays local-only (data/cache, app/config).
description: Lake sync contract between local development and S3. Logical LakeKey paths are identical on both sides.

s3_credentials.note: Use standard AWS SDK env vars (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3). Never commit credentials to app/config.

lake_root.scope: entire lake root — raw, silver, gold, serving, manifests
lake_root.rule: Same relative keys locally and on S3. No path rewrites on promote.

never_sync.reason: Rebuildable — skill caches, tantivy hydration, LRU. Regenerated locally.
Git is source of truth for config. Not stored in S3.

optional_sync.reason: Eval baselines and QA reports. Useful for CI, not runtime.

legacy_local_only.reason: Bootstrap import input. Absorbed into lake on import, then deprecated.
Pre-DAG format. Do not sync or use at runtime.

point_to_s3.step_2: backend reads/writes via object_store — zero code changes

cli_sync_examples.note: Prefer OPENESTATES_LAKE_URL=s3:// for production runtime. Use aws sync for bulk seed/migration only.

promotion.description: Promoting a serving bundle updates manifests/assets/search_serving_bundle/.../current.json in the lake. Sync propagates the pointer + new version folder.

integrity.content_hash: Parquet artifacts record sha256 in asset manifests
integrity.immutability: Never overwrite a version= folder in place. Write new version, update current.json pointer.
integrity.lineage: materialization_id links raw → silver → gold → serving
